question: 2ⁿd October is observed as _____________ .
solution:
The correct answer is__** International Non-Violence Day.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **October 2ⁿd** is celebrated as the birth anniversary of **Mahatma Gandhi,** who was a leader of the **Indian independence movement** and a pioneer of the **philosophy and strategy of non-violence**.
 
• The **United Nations General Assembly **declared **October 2ⁿd** as the** International Day of Non-Violence** in **2007** to disseminate the message of **non-violence**, including through education and public awareness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Social Justice Day** is observed on** February 20th** to promote **social justice** and eradicate **poverty, inequality, and discrimination.**
 
• **World Wildlife Day** is celebrated on **March 3rd **to raise awareness of the importance of wildlife and to promote **conservation and sustainable use of wildlife.**
 
• **International Education Day** is observed on **January 24th** to highlight the role of education in building a **peaceful and sustainable world.**
